facts.business: India Nippon Electricals Limited manufactures ignition systems, integrated starter generators (ISG), DC-DC converters, advanced sensors, controllers, and other electronic components for the automotive industry, primarily two-wheeler and three-wheeler segments.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Fair Valuation of unquoted equity investments (carrying value Rs. 26,412 lakhs) due to inherent subjectivity and dependence on unobservable estimates.

key_risks: High dependence on estimates and unobservable inputs for fair valuation of unquoted equity investments (Rs. 26,412 lakhs)
Contingent liabilities from disputed tax demands (Income tax: Rs. 1,490 lakhs, GST: Rs. 130 lakhs, Service tax: Rs. 3 lakhs)
Transition risk from legacy ICE platforms to advanced electronics and emerging mobility solutions
Execution risk in calibrated diversification strategy and technology investments
facts.related_party_note: No related party transactions in relation to CSR expenditure (contribution to a trust controlled by related parties: Nil for both FY 2025-26 and FY 2024-25).
